title: UI风格#52 - Cyberpunk Neon (赛博朋克霓虹)
description: 创建第52种UI风格：赛博朋克霓虹风格 - 霓虹灯光、高科技低生活、雨夜都市。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planAZ.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Cyberpunk Neon style When color palette Then features hot pink, electric blue, neon yellow, dark purple
Given Cyberpunk Neon style When typography Then uses cyber fonts: Orbitron, Rajdhani, or Share Tech Mono
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: Orbitron (headers 3.5rem bold), Rajdhani (body 0.95rem), Share Tech Mono (code)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Cyberpunk Neon style When layout Then neon signs, rainy streets, holographic ads, urban density
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: rain animation (50 drops), neon border with flicker, gradient background (deep-purple to cyber-black), 2-column grid layout

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Cyberpunk Neon style When UI elements Then neon glow, rain drops, holographic panels, glitch effects
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: rain-drop animation, neon-border-top with flicker, box-shadow glow effects, hover transitions with color change

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Cyberpunk Neon UI When functional Then includes street chat, netrunner agents, street stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: street-terminal with chat (300px messages), 4 netrunner cards (Dev_Netrunner/RAG_Corpo/PM_Fixer/Test_Techie) with ICE_BREAK/REP/DATA/UPLINK/CONTRACTS/CRED/TESTS stats

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Cyberpunk Neon UI When copy Then uses street slang: 'Netrunner', 'Jack In', 'Chrome', 'ICE'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: title 'NETRUN. JACK IN. CHROME.', tagline 'The street finds its own', button 'JACK IN', greeting 'Jack in successful. What's your hustle, choom?', status 'ONLINE'/'JACKED'/'OFFLINE'
